items.title: Mistral Vibe (formerly Le Chat) - AI chat and coding agent
items.snippet:
Mistral Vibe (formerly Le Chat) - AI chat and coding agent
[...]
What is Mistral Vibe?
[...]
Vibe is Mistral's AI chat assistant and agent for work and code. It combines an AI chat assistant (Vibe for work, formerly Le Chat) and an AI coding agent (Vibe for code) in a single product for individuals, teams, and enterprises.
[...]
Le Chat is now Vibe. All your conversations, settings, and plans carry over.

[...]
Mistral Vibe generates production-
[...]
code from natural language, refactors across files, auto-generates tests, reviews pull requests, documents APIs, migrates legacy codebases — all with full project context.

items.title: Mistral rebrands LeChat as Vibe, betting its chatbot's future is as a full-blown work agent
items.snippet:
# Mistral rebrands LeChat as Vibe, betting its chatbot's future is as a full-blown work agent
[...]
Mistral rebrands LeChat as Vibe, betting its chatbot's future is as a full-blown work agent
[...]
# Mistral rebrands LeChat as Vibe, betting its chatbot's future is as a full-blown work agent
[...]
- Mistral AI has rebranded its chatbot "Le Chat" as "Vibe" and repositioned it as a full AI work tool, featuring a "Work Mode" that connects with services like Google Workspace and Slack to handle tasks such as emails and reports.
[...]
- Vibe launches with four pricing tiers, though specific usage limits remain unclear. The rebrand consolidates Mistral's existing features into a single product aimed at competing directly with AI agents from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic.
[...]
Mistral AI is renaming Le Chat to Vibe, repositioning the former chatbot as a work tool that handles emails, writes reports, and ships code all the way to the pull request stage. Existing conversations and settings carry over, but the pricing is new.
[...]
The name "Vibe" already existed, by the way. Until the rebrand, it was Mistral's coding tool, available as a paid feature on Pro and Team since Vibe 2.0. Now the name has jumped from the coding agent to the whole assistant.
[...]
Over the past year, Le Chat gradually picked up Deep Research, a voice mode, image editing, MCP integrations, and a memory function. Work Mode and cloud-based coding agents followed in early May. Vibe bundles all of it under one brand and puts Mistral in more direct competition with the agentic versions of ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude.
[...]
The coding setup with parallel sandbox agents isn't unique. OpenAI has Codex, Anthropic has Claude code in the browser, and Cursor runs entire agent fleets in version three. Adding to the confusion, the Vibe name used to mean Mistral's coding assistant Vibe 2.0. Now it covers the whole product, work mode and all.
